title: Open Biocenter: a laboratory you can operate from anywhere
description:
An Open Biocenter is a building that holds machines instead of benches. Each machine automates one class of experiment and occupies one slot in a rack, and every operation available at the bench is available over the network.

This is the source of the project site at biocenter.opening.science, a single self-contained page. The first prototype, the OpenDrop BioServer, was installed on 1 September 2026 in Interlaken, Switzerland.

Typefaces are licensed commercially and are excluded from this archive.
